question: Should OpenClaw accept this CLI trust-state contract, where marketplace JSON/text output includes `signedBy` but diagnostics expose only bounded verification facts?
rationale: The code is mechanically narrow and correct, but signed-feed trust display and diagnostic redaction are security-boundary/operator UX choices that green CI cannot decide.

options.title: Accept after exact-head CI

options.body: Ask for a narrower or differently named trust output shape before merge if exposing `signedBy` in operator output is not the desired contract.

options.title: Pause for default-feed rollout
